# ThreadSanitizer (TSan) Suppressions for Expanse
#
# Expanse uses Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) with seqlock version
# validation (SeqVersion / SeqVersion32) and Epoch-Based Reclamation (EBR).
# Readers perform optimistic (plain) loads of trie nodes and leaf arrays
# concurrently with single-writer mutations.
#
# MATCHING SEMANTICS & RESIDUAL COVERAGE BOUNDARIES:
# 1. LLVM TSan suppression patterns match by substring against any frame in the
#    backtrace of EITHER racing thread.
# 2. File patterns like `race:map.rs` match as substrings, covering any path
#    containing `map.rs` (`map.rs`, `mutate_map.rs`, `bytesmap.rs`, `strmap.rs`,
#    `blobmap.rs`). They are listed explicitly below for documentation clarity.
# 3. Because every storage data race has a write side executing in one of the
#    suppressed storage files (`mutate_map.rs`, `mutate.rs`, `map.rs`, `trie32.rs`),
#    any race touching node/leaf arrays is suppressed by the write-side frame.
# 4. Consequently, an unbracketed in-place mutation racing an optimistic reader
#    (#477/#479) is TSan-invisible. That bug class is caught deterministically by
#    `assert_bracketed()` debug panics in `NodeAlloc`, Loom model checks (`loom_`),
#    and linearizability history recording (`tests/linearizability.rs`), NOT by TSan.
# 5. For 32-bit targets (`sync32`), both the validated read (`map_get_validated`)
#    and deferred node drop execution (`drain_pending`) execute within `trie32.rs`.
#    Reclamation UAF races are caught by ASan and Loom, not TSan.
# 6. TSan residual coverage: catches races where BOTH racing stacks remain outside
#    the storage files (e.g. non-storage synchronization coordination, external
#    test harnesses, and language binding state).

# Demangled symbol path patterns
race:expanse_trie::map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate_map::*
race:expanse_trie::mutate::*
race:expanse_trie::set::*
race:expanse_trie::bits::*
race:expanse_trie::slot::*
race:expanse_trie::trie32::*
race:expanse_trie::bytesmap::*
race:expanse_trie::strmap::*
race:expanse_trie::blobmap::*

# Source file substring patterns for storage engines
race:map.rs
race:mutate_map.rs
race:mutate.rs
race:set.rs
race:bits.rs
race:slot.rs
race:bytesmap.rs
race:strmap.rs
race:blobmap.rs
race:trie32.rs
